name: The Celestial Fracture

relationships.label: The Celestial Fracture struck Northern Velkaris, raining moon fragments across the frozen region and forever altering its landscape and magic.
A colossal moon fragment directly impacted Greyvast, shattering its ancient capital, submerging the kingdom in eternal mist, and reducing the once-proud realm to the Sunken Throne.
Vel-Thara the Unmade coalesced from the spiritual and magical fallout of the Celestial Fracture, emerging as a new deity of decay born from cosmic sorrow.
Mourne the Hollow King was forged from the cumulative soul-debt and spiritual void left by the Fracture's magical fallout, embodying the ultimate price of Soulmancy.
Yssara of the Shattered Moon coalesced from the raw, untamed magical energies violently released by the Celestial Fracture, becoming the living embodiment of the broken moon's power.
The Celestial Fracture bathed what would become the Pale Dominion in diffuse, soul-sapping magical fallout, fundamentally altering the landscape and birthing their philosophy of controlled decay.
The Fracture brought perpetual winter and ashfall to Valdenmoor, turning a thriving kingdom into a dying land locked in slow entropic decay.

description: The Celestial Fracture is the defining cataclysm of Northern Velkaris — the night the sky cracked open two centuries ago and moon fragments rained upon the world. What was once a single, pale celestial body shattered into countless shards, each embedded in the frozen earth like a festering shard of power. The event released a wave of raw, untamed magic that fundamentally rewrote the laws of the region: time flows strangely near the larger fragments, soul erosion became an endemic curse, and three new deities were born from the fallout. The Fracture ended the old era and birthed the Age of Fracture, a time of gradual decay punctuated by desperate acts of survival. Everything in Northern Velkaris — its wars, its religions, its dying kingdoms, its forbidden rituals — traces back to this single moment.
excerpt: The Celestial Fracture was the defining cataclysm of Northern Velkaris — the night the sky cracked open two centuries ago, releasing raw magic, birthing three new gods, and dooming the land to slow entropic decay.
content: Two hundred years ago, on the longest night of the year, the moon shattered without warning. The event was not silent — witnesses described a sound like the world's own bones breaking, followed by a light so intense it bleached the sky white for three days. Moon fragments — some the size of keeps — plummeted into Northern Velkaris, embedding themselves in glaciers, mountains, and the seabeds of frozen fjords. The largest fragment struck what is now Greyvast, instantly vaporizing the capital and leaving behind a crater that filled with mist and seawater. The magical aftershocks rippled outward for months, warping the fabric of reality. New forms of magic emerged — Soulmancy, Fragment-binding, Moon-tongue — but at a terrible cost. The Fracture's corruption seeps into anyone who stays too long near a fragment, eroding memory, identity, and eventually the soul. The three entities that would become gods — Vel-Thara, Mourne, and Yssara — first manifested within the first year after the Fracture, each embodying a different aspect of the catastrophe. The old gods fell silent. The Age of Fracture began.
